name: FieldWorks
description: Tier C remains appropriate for the narrow Windows updater behavior: background metadata checking and installer download occur over configured HTTPS, selected EXE/MSP files are retained, and the local installer is later handed to ProcRunner without an application-level artifact verifier. The word silent is contradicted by the Yes/No installation dialog, so that part requires correction. The lack of a check in this application path cannot establish a release-wide absence of signing or hashing, and it does not justify changing the tier on that basis.
limitations: Snapshot is commit 251843173cac81f20b89261c9802a503ba745620 from a newly retrieved default branch, not the original study checkout.
The source does not independently verify historical or current release artifact signatures, hashes, or server-side metadata authenticity.
FLEx Bridge has separate prompting and installer handling; this audit does not generalize the regular FieldWorks path to every product component.
